verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs list compiler-accurate cross-file analysis for eight languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, Scala, C# and Rust. That covers much of the language side of the story. Nothing in the pack shows package-ecosystem or dependency scanning, and other common languages such as C/C++, PHP and Ruby are not documented. Missing for 10: package ecosystem / dependency (SCA) coverage, documented support for C/C++, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin and Swift, and independent corroboration of language coverage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scan projects across all the major languages and package ecosystems my organization uses
